soon.manual: Here you'll see your business's operations manual as the firms write it and you approve it.
soon.documents: Here you'll have every document of your program in one place: approved deliverables, contracts and files you uploaded.
soon.numbers: Here you'll see your business's key numbers: sales, margin and the financial models your finance firm prepares.
soon.business: Here you'll see and update your business details: contact, industry, team and locations.
soon.businesses: Here you'll see every business in the program with its day, progress, health by area and the firm for each area.
soon.catalog: Here you'll see the Método 180 catalog tasks and each firm's team. Only SM Global edits the catalog; the office reads it.
soon.settings: Here you'll set up the office details, its people and general preferences.
